rationale: Claimant's own plumbing failed, causing direct damage to the home's interior structure (hardwood floor, drywall) and contents (stored boxes).
claim_summary: Homeowner Sam Patel (POL-1004) returned from work trip to find basement flooded with 2 inches of water caused by plumbing failure. Damage includes buckled hardwood floor, drywall soaked up to 1 foot, and ruined stored contents. High-severity claim requiring on-site adjuster assessment and water damage mitigation coordination.

case_facts.description: Basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water across entire floor
case_facts.damage_details: Hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to 1 foot high, stored boxes ruined

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) is straightforward property damage to covered real property.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; four shingles blown off with no interior water damage. Claimant estimates $400 repair cost. Policy deductible is $2,500—claim amount falls below deductible threshold and is not payable.

case_facts.description: Four shingles blown off overhang above back porch
